schema.description: Authenticated user data. Profile fields (email, phone, first_name/middle_name/last_name/full_name, profile_photo_url, legal_data, birthday, gender, languages, timezone, accessibility_resources, disability_disclosure) are only returned when the token carries the corresponding scope (email, phone, profile, profile.legal, profile.birthday, profile.identity, profile.communication, profile.preferences, profile.accessibility) or the all scope.

id.description: ID of the user (deprecated, use uid)

intercom_id.description: ID of the user used for identification in Intercom

created_via_api.description: Indicates if it was created via API

profile_photo_url.description: URL of profile photo (ActiveStorage) or Gravatar as fallback

gender.description: Gender identity (undisclosed, woman, man, non_binary, other_identity or free value — profile.identity scope)

accessibility_resources.description: Accessibility resources used on the platform (profile.accessibility scope)

disability_disclosure.description: Disabilities reported by the user, optional (profile.accessibility scope)

schema.title: v2_user

body.description: Information of the user to be added.
